Name: Harvey - Off The Clock
Author: novust
Description:
[size=4][b][img]https://i.ibb.co/4nSpk6hp/description.png[/img][/b][/size]

[i]Harvey - Off The Clock [/i][color=#D4D4D8]features over 15 heart events that deepen the farmer's relationship with him, from close friends to madly in love. [/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][b](Stuck? See my spoiler-free [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/4505]Heart Events Guide[/url] article!)[/b][/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][i]          ** Content warnings: **[/i][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][i]• Slightly suggestive content (nothing that surpasses Emily's vanilla camping event)[/i][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][i]• Brief mention of loneliness, depression, and not being alive (less than Shane's vanilla storyline)[/i][/color]


[size=4][b][img]https://i.ibb.co/FqNzB6cX/requirements-installation.png[/img][/b][/size]

[color=#D4D4D8]• Make sure you have the most recent versions of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].[/color]
• Download and put into your Mods folder the usual way. Done!


[color=#D4D4D8][img]https://i.ibb.co/Hpk9sGcQ/compatibility.png[/img][/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]• Compatible with almost every mod, as long as it doesn't edit or change Harvey's room in any way. One single exception: [b]It [u]is[/u] compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]! [/b]My mod auto-detects if you have SVE installed or not (no config needed); all differences are visual only.[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]• Compatible with other Harvey mods on a [i][b]purely technical[/b][/i] level (again, as long as they don't change his room), but I can't guarantee they will make sense story-wise. If you play with another Harvey mod at the same time, I would appreciate if you [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/52624?tab=posts]let me know[/url] if they make sense together or not![/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]• Untested in multiplayer or Android - please [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/52624?tab=posts]let me know[/url] if they work for you.[/color]


[img]https://i.ibb.co/ycyk1FmH/mods-pictured.png[/img]

• [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37478]Bearded Bachelors[/url] ("well-groomed" option)
• [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url] 
[color=#D4D4D8]• [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13608]Better Clinic Beds[/url][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]• [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] [/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]
[b][img]https://i.ibb.co/GvhKCwBB/mod-recommendations.png[/img][/b]

[i]Not required,[/i] but I highly recommend using this mod with:[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]• [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8505]Event Lookup[/url] and/or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39885]MH Event List[/url] (they are very useful, and make my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/4505]Heart Events Guide[/url] obsolete!)[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]• [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30863]NPC Relationship Tweaks[/url] (to change some vanilla dialogue re: Maru, that many of us find icky) [/color]


[color=#D4D4D8][img]https://i.ibb.co/gFvr0wMd/what-s-next.png[/img][/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]• Fixing any issues or mistakes; please let me know in the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/52624?tab=posts]Posts[/url] section if you find any bugs, typos, or inconsistencies.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]• Maybe some marriage events or passive dialogue, depending on interest.[/color]


[img]https://i.ibb.co/tdZhGH9/my-other-mods.png[/img]

• [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/49486]Tutti Fruity - Yet Another Furniture Recolour (AT or CP)[/url] (my biggest mod)
• [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/45924]Gems and Minerals - Yet Another Rug Recolour (AT or CP)[/url] (my first original mod)
• [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/45895]Roasted Veggie Plate[/url] (a practice mod using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43811]Modder's Pie - A Complete Tutorial For Your First Mod[/url])


[size=4][b][img]https://i.ibb.co/bMq0frHX/credits-special-thanks.png[/img][/b][/size]

• My spouse for being my in-house IT and sounding board.
[color=#D4D4D8]• [b]ConcernedApe[/b] for making this amazing game, and for encouraging us to make mods.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]• The mod authors who gave us SMAPI, Content Patcher, SVE, Bearded Bachelors, Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic, Better Clinic Beds, Event Lookup, MH Event List, NPC Relationship Tweaks, and of course, Modder's Pie.[/color]
• And a special shout-out to the mod author of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43764]Stardew Local API[/url]... Not only would my mod not exist without it, but I've learned so much about making cutscenes by using their mod as a jumping off point and bridging the gap with modding tutorials.


[color=#D4D4D8][b][img]https://i.ibb.co/27RhJYZQ/p-s.png[/img][/b][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]
If you enjoy a mod, please consider endorsing it — it helps with visibility, and encourages mod authors to make more![/b] [/color]
